pronunciation.approximation: Say "kamapuaa" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Kamapuaa".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "kamapuaa" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "Kamapuaa" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: Kamapuaa
domains.subtitle: Pig God
domains.lead: Kamapuaa is pig god, agriculture. The name means "male fertility deity in Hawaiian mythology" and belongs to the polynesian tradition.

mythology.lead: The stories of Kamapuaa place pig god, agriculture at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Kamapuaa appears in polynesian tradition as pig god, agriculture. The name's meaning, "male fertility deity in Hawaiian mythology", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Kamapuaa in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Kamapuaa remains a touchstone for understanding polynesian religion, art, and identity.
